source_anchors: symbol-bindings.json caller_edges CJ01-CJ15; full path/line/blob/declaration digest

old_labels.meaning: Best-effort process identity recording returning void, not owner confirmation.
Actual wrapper and inner startup caller; do not infer a nonexistent startSeat operation.

source_branches.condition: ensureSeatInner invokes instanceStore.claim before setting claim.instanceId
source_branches.observed: InstanceStore.claim mutates busy then saves. If that save throws, the outer marker is still null; ensureSeat catch does not call releaseAllFor. Memory may hold a claim even before the fake child starts.
source_branches.required: Represent claim attempt, durable claim and startup ownership separately. Reconcile a partially recorded claim; neither success nor no-side-effect may be inferred from the wrapper marker.

source_branches.condition: Missing record, busy entry, matching seat binding, PID, or a usable processStartedAt response
source_branches.observed: noteProcess returns void without save on the early paths. processStartedAt returns null for invalid PID, empty output, absent process OR command exception/timeout. The calling persistent path has no return-value check for a verified/durable owner and can continue to home/account inspection and publication.
source_branches.required: UNKNOWN/NOT_RECORDED is not EXITED, authenticated identity or durable ownership. Keep prior custody and root/writer fences; do not allow reallocation from a void return or missing PID.

source_branches.condition: Known identity in managed and host branches
source_branches.observed: Managed record.busy or hostBusy[id] is changed before save. save is mkdir -> fixed instances.json.tmp write -> rename. It has no file/directory fsync, cross-writer lock or rollback in this method. Save errors can leave in-memory identity ahead of disk; rename failure can leave the temp and old target.
source_branches.required: Typed ownership must distinguish observed process identity, in-memory state, persisted record and durability acknowledgment. Preserve partial-write diagnostics without declaring an owner confirmed. Existing W30/RT32 policy remains; do not adopt this store as public authority.

source_branches.condition: An exception after a claim, including noteProcess save or later probeEffectiveHome failure after seat.start
source_branches.observed: ensureSeat catch calls releaseAllFor based on claim.instanceId, not on child exit. releaseAllFor clears every matching non-orphaned managed/host busy record, preserves orphaned and other-seat entries, and saves only when dirty. It does not query, close or kill the child. A save error occurs after memory was cleared; an error from rollback can replace the original thrown error.
source_branches.required: Cleanup intent, busy-record release and actual process exit are different facts. Carry original plus cleanup errors, retain uncertain PID/start identity and durable residual custody, prevent a new writer until WP03 exit/descendant/writer conditions are satisfied. Do not fix or adopt all of Room during P00.
